jobs.title: Manager, Organic and AI Strategy and Performance
jobs.description:
Role Specific Information

Job Description

About the Role
As Manager, Organic & AI Search Strategy & Performance you will lead the team responsible for driving high-impact search growth across Kohls.com. You will bridge operational leadership with cross-functional strategy, combining core content execution, performance leadership, and emerging-discovery innovation to build Kohl’s authority, visibility, and commercial impact at scale across traditional search engines (Google, Bing) and emerging AI answer platforms Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Large Language Models (LLMs), and bots.

What You’ll Do
- Serve as the leader for Kohl’s organic search footprint, translating high-level business goals into a multi-year growth strategy while defining and championing the integrated vision for AI Search Visibility, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and traditional organic search performance across the enterprise
- Provide leadership and oversight across core operations, intelligence bridge, and innovation pillars, ensuring operational handoffs, testing pipelines, and scaling workflows run seamlessly to build Kohl’s authority, visibility, and commercial impact
- Build and retain a highly functioning, collaborative, and future-focused team culture, driving a "Run, Improve, Transform" mindset while fostering continuous learning, psychological safety, and clear growth pathways for team members across all grade levels
- Establish deep strategic partnerships with Digital Engineering/IT, Product Management, Marketing, and Merchandising teams to ensure organic search priorities are integrated into enterprise platforms and site initiatives
- Drive organizational buy-in for new search paradigms, leading the transition from traditional keyword search to AI-driven answer engines across partner teams
- Build data-backed business cases to secure investment for tools, technical resources, vendor partnerships, and team development
- Champion innovation initiatives (AEO, GEO, agentic workflows, LLM optimization) and ensure discoveries successfully transition into scalable, core content operations
- Oversee the strategic direction for content optimization across high-volume catalog/Product Matrix Page (PMP) and Product Detail Page (PDP) pages to maximize search visibility, customer engagement, and conversion
- Act as the primary liaison to Digital leadership, translating complex search trends, algorithm changes, and macro health metrics into clear business-value updates
- Oversee strategic relationships with external technology partners, enterprise platforms, search engines (Google), and agencies to maximize ROI and beta opportunities
- Additional tasks may be assigned

What Skills You Have
Required
- 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing, e-commerce, digital content performance, or search marketing within a large retail or high-volume transactional ecosystem
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Business Administration, or Information Systems
- Proven track record of managing, developing, and inspiring multi-tiered teams to achieve business results and foster high engagement
- Exceptional ability to collaborate with and influence cross-functional executives, engineering leads, product managers, and marketing teams without direct authority
- Demonstrated expertise in building data-driven business cases, managing channel budgets, and translating macro digital performance into business insights

Preferred
- Experience leading multi-disciplinary digital teams in a major omni-channel retail environment
- Broad understanding of digital search dynamics, content optimization engines, and the business impact of emerging AI search platforms (ChatGPT, Google Gemini, AI Overviews)
- Proven success designing cross-departmental frameworks, SLAs, and governance models for digital execution

jobs.description:
Role Specific Information

Job Description

This role is based at our Corporate Office in Menomonee Falls, WI. You’ll work onsite from Monday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Fridays.

About the Role
As Senior Recruitment Marketing Analyst, you will develop, create and execute recruitment marketing strategies to build and strengthen Kohl’s employer brand and increase candidate engagement. You will use data to drive business results and deeply understand the recruiting and talent ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

- Manage and maintain budget and strategy decisions and share best practices and recommendations to increase brand awareness and candidate traffic
- Create talent attraction strategies for key job openings and talent pipelines, including media planning, campaign management, optimization and recommendations
- Manage vendor relationships as the primary contact for escalation, negotiate and advise on contract terms and renewals and hold vendors accountable to KPIs and SLAs
- Manage programmatic and recruitment partnerships by analyzing funnel metrics and vendor reports to allocate budget and optimize job board investments while collaborating with account teams to launch and monitor campaigns for maximum ROI and strategic vendor utilization
- Measure campaign impact and the success of content strategy through analysis of related KPIs and the utilization of web analytics tools and marketing automation platforms
- Manage CRM email campaign development and execution, partnering across teams to optimize workflows, coordinate creative assets, and ensure accurate performance tracking
- Lead the careers site strategy by recommending and executing updates to the Content Management System (CMS), including enhancing site design, improving overall functionality, and source mapping for applicant tracking.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously from inception to completion, including planning, resource allocation and timeline management
- Lead the review and creation of job advertisements across all business units, managing the entire process, including training team members to ensure content accuracy and alignment with Kohl’s brand voice
